Method of Attack: Used as a botnet infrastructure to manage infected computers, spread malware, serve other criminal groups, and resist takedown attempts; Drops second-stage malware payloads; Acts as a primary door opener for unauthorized access to computer systems globally; Uses massive volumes of emails with fake replies or forwarded emails and password-protected archive attachments to deliver malware
